title: status.json additions — schema 2.0.0, required-pairing feature marker 1
description: Current additive regions; missing regions in older files are tolerated. Required pairing migration is determined by feature marker and pre-existing progress, never schema version.

machine_profile.description: What the Press Start wizard learned about this computer (FR-001). Never contains anything the client typed — detection only, plus the one chosen-surface answer.

os.description: 'macos' | 'windows' | 'linux' | raw process.platform value for anything else.

surfaces_found.description: Best-effort filesystem/PATH detection (research.md R1; codex added 2026-07-26 after the founder walkthrough). Absence from this list never means 'not installed'.

chosen_surface.description: Historical detection value only; supported installed runtimes are codex and claude-code. Website-only cannot pass required pairing.

sharing.description: Operational connection required for supported work, subject to one-time existing-user grace; fresh server verification required. See 007 contract.

radio_choice.description: Prior declined choice persists until explicit pairing; accepted only after explicit code pairing.

bridge_url.description: Server address returned by code exchange.

install_token.description: Exchange-only credential, never displayed or pasted. Null in homed folders; machine-local radio.key or established cloud attachment supplies it.

packages.description: Installed-package record, keyed by slug (FR-005/FR-007; Article II). Written the moment a smoke test passes, read for shelf reports and resume.

smoke_test_passed.description: true only after the package's live check on the client's own data (Article VIII) — never optimistically.
